briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier model race with new 10T parameter clusters

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as major labs push toward multimodal superintelligence. Funding surges in compute infrastructure while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled agent deployments. Prompt injection and multi-agent coordination remain critical vulnerabilities across production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with native tool use; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 Ultra; xAI activates Colossus-2 cluster for Grok-3 training; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant; DeepSeek launches R2 reasoning model.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators push for mandatory red-teaming standards ahead of EU AI Act enforcement. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra racks to Microsoft and xAI; TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators; new hyperscale data centers announced in Texas and Iceland totaling 50GW capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 100T parameter model trigger an irreversible intelligence explosion before 2028?
